jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

At the heart of Discord's communities is Safety. The Safety team at Discord is responsible for ensuring users find belonging by minimizing exposure to abuse on the platform. We're looking for a Product Manager to lead our work on scaled abuse — fake accounts, account takeovers, scraping — and help keep Discord a safe and welcoming place.

Reporting to our safety Group Product Manager, you'll create the vision, build the systems, and lead the cross-functional strategy that detects and prevents scaled abuse before it reaches our users. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role with significant room to shape strategy, drive investment, and define how we measure and win in this space.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own the product philosophy, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap for scaled abuse, spanning fake accounts, ATO, scraping, and recidivism detection — prioritizing proactive, foundational investments that compound across the platform.

• Define, own, and socialize the north-star metrics for the space and report progress against those goals to the relevant stakeholders.

• Translate threat research into forward-looking defensive product work, so our roadmap focus’s on the highest-leverage defensive investments rather than one-off firefights

• Drive cross-functional execution with growth, security, anti-abuse and product teams to minimize impact of abuse on our users. This work spans machine learning solutions, heuristics, and building delightful features in-app.

• Partner with product teams across Discord to embed abuse resistance into new surfaces before they ship.

What you should have

• Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, excited about finding solutions to complex, adversarial problems and then executing on them.

• Passionate about Discord and about keeping users safe from abuse at scale.

• 5+ years of experience as a product manager building and shipping great software, including driving prioritization, trade-offs, and timelines. Some of that experience should include designing and shipping user-facing anti-abuse features.

• Strong product sense and pride in understanding Discord and our users.

• Strong analytical ability to quickly organize and leverage data to make informed product decisions with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Previous work in spam, abuse, fraud, account integrity, Trust & Safety, or a strong passion to learn the space.

• Sufficient technical domain expertise to drive alignment on technical requirements with Anti-Abuse, ML, and Security stakeholders.

Bonus Points

• Familiarity with ML-based detection systems and adversarial attacker dynamics.

• BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant technical experience.

• Strong sense of delightful UI and UX design.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $196,000 to $220,500+ equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, US

Applications will be accepted until November 01, 2026.

Job Title: Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer

About the Role

This Senior Oracle Security and AI Engineer is primarily responsible for the Oracle Fusion security architecture, role design governance, oversight of the Risk Management Cloud service and AI initiatives. The Engineer serves as a hands-on expert for the technical administration, environment management, and platform integrity of the Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud environment, operating as a technical owner for Oracle Fusion Applications, Security, and the underlying Cloud and AI Infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Environment Management & Maintenance: Own the technical management of all Fusion environments, including executing scheduled environment refreshes , cloning instances, managing environment usage, and ensuring system configuration baselines.

• Cloud Update Execution: Participate in the technical preparation and execution of Oracle’s mandatory quarterly cloud updates, including performing pre-update checks and technical smoke testing post-update.

• Platform Stability & Governance: Own the non-functional requirements for the Oracle Cloud environment, including security architecture, role design governance, and performance benchmarking. Enforce technical configuration control standards.

• Security Administration: Provide security administration and support for all Oracle Fusion Applications, PaaS and DBaaS platforms. Design, build, and deploy custom security roles for Oracle Fusion Applications, ensuring strict adherence to the principle of least privilege and Segregation of Duties and Sensitive Access compliance frameworks.

• Risk Management Cloud: Serve as the technical owner of the Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud service. Configure, deploy, and maintain Advanced Access Controls - AAC and Advanced Financial Controls - AFC to detect and mitigate financial risks, fraud, and policy violations, translating audit requirements into effective platform controls.

• Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Provide Level 2/3 technical support for environment-related issues, access problems, and deployment failures. Serve as an escalation point to conduct root cause analysis for platform-level incidents.

• AI & Automation Innovation: Evaluate, design, and deploy AI-driven tools, Model Context Protocol implementations/maintenance, Terraform-based automation scripts, and security artifacts to enhance platform security operations, streamline threat monitoring, and optimize governance workflows across the Oracle Cloud ecosystem.

Role Requirements

Must-Have Skills

• 8+ years focusing on the technical administration/support within Oracle eco system

• 4+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying custom security roles within the Oracle Fusion Applications environment.

• Expert-level knowledge of managing Oracle Fusion Cloud environments(ERP, GTM and EPM), including environment refresh and cloning processes.

• Deep technical familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure administration and monitoring.

• Strong understanding of security architecture, Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud, role design governance, and performance management within a cloud ERP.

• Strong understanding of various MCP and Agentic capabilities with Oracle Fusion (ERP, EPM, GTM), AI Database, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence.

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience in an organization transitioning to Oracle Cloud Ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience with various OCI PaaS Toolsets.

• Exposure to the Data Center Infrastructure industry

• Relevant professional product/functional certifications (e.g., Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Security certifications)

• Skilled in administering DevOps tools like Flexagon FlexDeploy and using Opal IGA tool

• Experience in Cloudflare’s Developer platform or equivalent(e.g., AWS)

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
